text:
sam: Quick sync — NimbusHealth and ByteCart both asked for stronger burst guarantees but they also want cost predictability. Need final policy before we lock roadmap.
leila: TL;DR customers want: temporary headroom during traffic spikes + clear invoice lines. Also opt-out safe defaults.
chen: Engineering note: we can provide headroom two ways — prewarm (idle GPU-hours) or fast-scaling with warm cache pins. Prewarm is expensive but gives latency guarantees.
deepa: Ops: if we do prewarm-heavy strategy, runbook must include real-time cost burn dashboards + automated scale-down windows. Also require a fast abort if queue latency increases.
maria_pm: Proposal A: "guaranteed micro-prewarm" — reserve N warm slots per tenant during surge, billed as prewarm-hours; capped and configurable. Proposal B: "elastic surge" — no reserved warm slots; burst served best-effort with admission controls.
josh_sales: Sales will sell micro-prewarm to enterprise, but SMBs prefer elastic surge at lower cost. Need concrete tiers: default (elastic), premium (micro-prewarm 20% RUs/day), enterprise (custom).
leila: Suggest default elastic with a 10%/day soft-burst budget (sliding 24h). Premium adds explicit prewarm-hours and priority admission.
chen: Implementation sketch: tokenized "surge_ticket" per tenant. When a tenant consumes tickets, we either activate prewarm slots or increase scheduling priority with KV-pin timeout extension. Tickets renewal rate = burst_pct * committed_RU.
sample config:
```json
{"policy":"micro_prewarm_v1","burst_window":"24h","burst_pct_default":"10","prewarm_slots_per_ticket":"2","max_concurrent_tickets":"5","fallback":"model_variant|cross_region_spill"}
```
deepa: Runbook bullets: immediate action if queue_time_p50>150ms and p99>800ms for 2 consecutive 30s windows: 1) throttle low-priority tenants, 2) flip customer to fallback model variant, 3) if still high, enable cross-region spill. Also alert ops and customer success.
maria_pm: Launch criteria draft:
- telemetry: per-tenant burst_ticket_consumed, p50/p90/p99 latency, prewarm_gpu_hours, cost_estimate delta
- pilots: NimbusHealth (healthcare, us-east), ByteCart (ecom, eu-west), and an internal stress test
- GA quality gate: no >3% regression on eval prompt set during burst for pilot tenants
- billing: line-item for burst tickets and prewarm-hours with a clear cap and overage rules
- rollback: ability to disable surge per-tenant within 30s
leila: UX: console should show a small "burst" card per reserved pool with usage bar and remaining tickets. I'll mock.
chen: Infra ask: need 30 days of historical QPS + token distribution for top 25 tenants to model expected ticket burn. I'll run sims.
josh_sales: Also need sample SLA verbiage for contracts. They want to know what "guaranteed" means (e.g., p99 latency target during prewarm-backed surge).
sam: Decision list for tomorrow:
1) default burst_pct (10 vs 12 vs 15) and whether sliding 24h is the right unit
2) prewarm vs elastic defaults for tiers
3) concurrent ticket cap per tenant
4) pilot customer opt-in process and billing line-item format
deepa: I'll draft the circuit-breaker playbook and automation snippets. ch en: I'll post simulation numbers by EOD. leila: UI mock Wed. maria_pm: I'll draft pilot outreach + SLA wording. ops-bot: Canary scheduled: policy "micro_prewarm_v1" deploy to staging at 2024-09-03T14:00Z.
sam: Thanks all — reconvene tomorrow 9am PT. Ping me for changes. :rocket:
